name: Nova Tweaks Silent Power Plan
description: Creates a custom power plan to reduce fan noise and heat while maintaining system responsiveness for quiet everyday use.

description_i18n.en: Creates a custom power plan to reduce fan noise and heat while maintaining system responsiveness for quiet everyday use.
description_i18n.de: Erstellt einen benutzerdefinierten Energieplan, um Lüftergeräusche und Hitze zu reduzieren bei gleichzeitiger Aufrechterhaltung der Systemreaktionsfähigkeit für leisen Alltagsgebrauch.
description_i18n.fr: Crée un plan d'alimentation personnalisé pour réduire le bruit des ventilateurs et la chaleur tout en maintenant la réactivité du système pour une utilisation quotidienne silencieuse.

warnings.title: Power behavior change
warnings.message: Power behavior may change, which can affect battery life, heat, or fan noise

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Creates a new power scheme based on the Balanced or High Performance profile and modifies processor performance settings including minimum/maximum processor states, energy package preference, cooling policies, boost behavior, and parking thresholds
compact_description: Prioritizes low noise, low heat, and minimal power draw for quiet everyday operation.
